However, several claims go beyond or against the evidence, and some cited IDs are not on the card, so an investigator would have to redo checking.","problems":["Claims 'elevated in every complexity band' and 'two to three times the all-provider rate in every complexity band'; the card ratios range from about 2.5x (0 conditions: 0.054 vs 0.022) to 3x (1 condition), and 2x for 5+ (0.4 vs 0.202), so the 'two to three' range is roughly fair, but the all-provider comparison is not peer-adjusted and z vs peers is only 1.19, so the headline is overstated.","Says the billing pattern 'is consistent with upcoding' while the leaning is inconclusive and the z-score is modest; mixed message.","Flagged note IDs (C0196693, C0196753, C0196771, C0198343, C0198384, C0198431) and the note-check shares (problems 38%, late 4%, data 9%) do not appear on the evidence card, so they cannot be verified from the packet.","Interprets C0196955 and C0198770 as 'Z09 follow-ups' and 'R21 rash/J06.9 URI'; C0198770 has only J06.9 and the diagnosis-code descriptions are inferences. The 'weakly suggests templated or inflated notes' is speculative from 4 of 33.","The one below-billed example C0197337 has MDM moderate with minutes not recorded, which is fine, but the summary does not state that the only below-billed note is a single claim, so the 6% rests on n=17.","Example claims C0196793 and C0196955 are fixed-format and thin (age and condition count only); no high-complexity contrast claims cited."]}
